result.summary: Overall the page renders well, but there are a couple of visual problems: the Android gesture/navigation bar appears to overlap the bottom navigation icons, and the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: A dark horizontal bar (system gesture indicator or scrollbar) overlaps the bottom navigation bar, covering the search and bookmarks icons and making them look broken or misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset handling (e.g., safe-area insets) so the system gesture bar does not overlap the navigation icons.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccolo) is clipped at the right edge of the screen with no visible affordance that the row scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Keep the partial card but add a subtle edge fade or peek spacing to hint at horizontal scrolling, or reduce card widths so more cards fit.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner's decorative circles slightly reduce contrast of the white text on the right side.
issues.suggestion: Ensure overlay decorations keep sufficient contrast with white text, or reduce their opacity.
